name: Baños de Montemayor (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Baños de Montemayor (a fountain above waves and a bath on red).
history: The arms and the flag of Baños de Montemayor were approved by the Order of 27 November 1992 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 17 December 1992, approved by the Consejero de Presidencia y Trabajo Manuel Amigo after the municipal council's approval on 10 November 1992.

features.role: Baños de Montemayor arms — fountain above waves and bath
